sections.body: A FOOD CHAIN shows what eats what: grass → rabbit → fox. The arrows show where the energy goes.
PRODUCERS (plants) make food from sunlight. CONSUMERS eat other living things. DECOMPOSERS (fungi, bacteria) break down dead things.
An ECOSYSTEM is all the living things in an area plus their environment, all depending on each other.
If one part of a food chain disappears, the others are affected. Fewer rabbits can mean fewer foxes.

quiz.q: In grass → grasshopper → frog → snake, what is the producer?
hints: Which one uses sunlight to make food?
In seaweed → fish → seal, the producer is the seaweed.
quiz.explain: Grass makes its own food from sunlight: it's the producer.

quiz.q: What would most likely happen to foxes if rabbits disappeared?
hints: If all the flowers vanished, bees would struggle to find food. Same idea.
quiz.explain: Foxes would struggle to find food, because rabbits are part of their food chain.
